resolution: Orders paid with credit card EMI can only be refunded to the same credit card; the bank may charge pre-closure fees.

customer_message: My return was rejected and nobody delivered the item back to me.

resolution: Furniture is not eligible for return under the Home and Kitchen rules; return declined.
